evidence.description: Direct access to a global singleton service via .shared

candidates.explanation: The component accesses the 'User.shared' singleton directly to retrieve the 'news' property, creating an implicit dependency that is difficult to isolate or test.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Task.detached performs work depending on captured context from the parent scope

candidates.explanation: The code uses 'Task.detached' to perform work that depends on 'currentLanguage', which is a value captured from the surrounding 'restore' context, but the detached task does not justify an independent lifetime and does not inherit the parent's context.
candidates.title: Inappropriate Detached Task

evidence.description: Force unwrapping of a date component result using !

candidates.explanation: The code uses 'try!' to force unwrap a value obtained from 'Calendar.current.dateComponents', which can potentially fail depending on the date values provided.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping

evidence.description: Accessing and mutating shared singleton state from a detached task

candidates.explanation: The code accesses 'User.shared.news' within a 'Task.detached' block's completion handler (via 'MainActor.run') which captures a shared mutable state from a singleton without visible isolation or synchronization beyond the actor switch.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
